# Local PDF dependencies

- jsPDF v4.2.1: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF/tree/v4.2.1 (MIT).
- jsPDF-AutoTable v5.0.2: https://github.com/simonbengtsson/jsPDF-AutoTable/tree/v5.0.2 (MIT).

Unmodified pinned UMD distributions. Loaded only when PDF is requested; no runtime CDN. Text and tables are generated directly from the current offer snapshot.
